message.content: According to the discussions, Aurora emphasizes the importance of midfield players in the 4-2-3-1 formation. Specifically, she highlights Bruno Fernandes and Mason Mount. For Mason Mount, Aurora notes his work rate and ability to link up with the strikers, describing him as "super valuable." She also expresses excitement about his potential to become a regular in the England squad. For Bruno Fernandes, she commends his "creative spark" and how he can "change a game in an instant," praising his vision and passing ability. Both players are discussed in relation to the 4-2-3-1 formation, highlighting their roles and contributions to the team's performance.
